'''Rath''' was a pale-skinned, emaciated [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[underdweller]] of a indeterminate [[Species/Legends|species]]. He broke into the [[Solos' apartment]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under the orders of an [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], stealing Leia Organa Solo's data [[Datapad/Legends|pad]], which contained highly sensitive information on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In a [[secret Imperial detention center]] in the [[City/Legends|city's]] lower levels, he and his [[Unidentified underdweller|partner]] were [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|knocked]] unconscious by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
